Load a dataset

Source: R/download.R
rgeomex_load.Rd

Reads a dataset of rgeomex. The file is downloaded the first time it is used (see rgeomex_cache_dir()); later it is read from the cache.

Usage

rgeomex_load(dataset, cve_edo = NULL)

Arguments

dataset

name of the dataset (see rgeomex_datasets()), for example "AGEM_inegi19_mx" or "blocks_ine20_mx".

cve_edo

INEGI state key(s), from "01" to "32" (numbers are also accepted). It is required for the datasets split by state ("AGEB_inegi_2019", "blocks_ine20_mx", "blocks_ine20_mx_centroid", "sectores_ine20_mx"); for the other datasets it filters the rows of the state(s).

Value

a sf object (a data.frame for "iter_2020_loc").

Author

Felipe Antonio Dzul Manzanilla felipe.dzul.m@gmail.com.

Examples

# \donttest{
yuc <- rgeomex_load("AGEM_inegi19_mx", cve_edo = "31")
#> Downloading AGEM_inegi19_mx.parquet (first use only)
blocks <- rgeomex_load("blocks_ine20_mx", cve_edo = "31")
# }
